test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: There are five friends - P, Q, R, S and T sitting in a row facing North. R is sitting exactly in the middle of the row. T is sitting to the immediate right and immediate left of S and R, respectively. Q is not sitting at the extreme end. Who is sitting second to the left of P?
solution:
**Five friends: **P, Q, R, S and T sitting in a row facing North

1) R is sitting exactly in the middle of the row.

2) T is sitting to the immediate right and immediate left of S and R, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96be7202579ea64f83d125d48fc7b2061abc11f02fbc74e337ec8fd2a8b9155f.png] 

3) Q is not sitting at the extreme end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7689a73e1a7b351d4d01b94edf92bc0800e2731dbb999b9270bd54f5d8e5216b.png] 

Clearly, we can see that R is sitting second to the left of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"R".**
